description_en: Queries a paginated list of notable security events
description_zh: 分页查询值得关注的安全事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-threat-event --start-time 1668496310000 --end-time 1749916800000 --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-2bl40000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeThreatEvent

parameters.help_en: The domain name that is protected by WAF. If you do not specify this parameter, security events for all domain names are queried
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 5. Valid values: 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为5，表示每页包含5条结果。取值范围为1-200
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

ThreatEvents.description_en: The list of notable security events
ThreatEvents.description_zh: 值得关注的安全事件列表

BlockRate.description_en: The percentage of attack requests that were blocked by WAF

EndTime.description_en: The time when the last attack occurred. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 最近攻击时间。格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

EventId.description_en: The ID of the security event

EventLevel.description_en:
The severity level of the security event. Valid values:

critical

high

medium

low
EventLevel.description_zh:
事件等级。取值：

critical：表示严重。
high：表示高危。
medium：表示中危。
low：表示低危

EventSrc.description_en:
The source IP address of the attack.

A security event may have multiple source IP addresses. This operation returns only one of them
EventSrc.description_zh:
攻击来源IP。
安全事件可能有多个攻击来源IP，本接口只返回一个

EventTag.description_en:
The type of the security event. Valid values:

MultipleDomainDirscan: a directory and file scan against multiple domain names.

SingleDomainDirscan: a directory and file scan against a single domain name.

MultipleDomainWebscan: a web vulnerability scan against multiple domain names.

SingleDomainWebscan: a web vulnerability scan against a single domain name.

MultipleDomainWebattack: a web vulnerability attack against multiple domain names.

SingleDomainWebattack: a web vulnerability attack against a single domain name.

SingleURLWebattack: a web vulnerability attack against a specific URL.

SingleURLSqlattack: an SQL injection attack against a specific URL.

SingleURLXssattack: an XSS attack against a specific URL.

WebshellUpload: an attack that attempts to upload backdoor trojans.

RandomVulnTest: a random web vulnerability probe
EventTag.description_zh:
事件名称。取值为：

MultipleDomainDirscan：表示针对多个域名的目录文件扫描。
SingleDomainDirscan：表示针对单个域名的目录文件扫描。
MultipleDomainWebscan：表示针对多个域名的Web漏洞扫描。
SingleDomainWebscan：表示针对单个域名的Web漏洞扫描。
MultipleDomainWebattack：表示针对多个域名的Web漏洞攻击。
SingleDomainWebattack：表示针对单个域名的Web漏洞攻击。
SingleURLWebattack：表示针对特定URL的Web漏洞攻击。
SingleURLSqlattack：表示针对特定URL的SQL注入漏洞攻击。
SingleURLXssattack：表示针对特定URL的XSS漏洞攻击。
WebshellUpload：表示尝试上传后门木马的攻击行为。
RandomVulnTest：表示随机的Web漏洞探测行为

EventTarget.description_en:
The protected object that is the target of the attack.

A security event may have multiple protected objects as targets. This operation returns only one of them
EventTarget.description_zh:
攻击目标防护对象。
安全事件可能有多个攻击目标防护对象，本接口只返回一个

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of security events that match the query conditions
